# Agent Python Tools

- repo: open-webui/openapi-servers
- repo_uri: https://github.com/open-webui/openapi-servers

## File: open-webui_openapi-servers/servers/time/main.py

Prompts

```
['run a fastapi server that returns the current UTC time in ISO format', 'run a fastapi server that returns the current local time in ISO format', 'build a fastapi endpoint that formats the current time using a custom strftime pattern and timezone', 'build a fastapi endpoint that converts a timestamp from one IANA timezone to another', 'build a fastapi endpoint that calculates elapsed time between two ISO timestamps in seconds minutes hours or days']
```

Usage

```
{'run_fastapi_utc_time_server': 'run a fastapi server that returns the current UTC time in ISO format', 'run_fastapi_local_time_server': 'run a fastapi server that returns the current local time in ISO format', 'build_time_format_endpoint': 'build a fastapi endpoint that formats the current time using a custom strftime pattern and timezone', 'build_timezone_converter_endpoint': 'build a fastapi endpoint that converts a timestamp from one IANA timezone to another', 'build_elapsed_time_endpoint': 'build a fastapi endpoint that calculates elapsed time between two ISO timestamps in seconds minutes hours or days'}
```
